title: WorkspaceRoles
description: Output of `dmtool workspace roles <dir>` — the workspace roles lint (FEATURE-GAPS R3). Resolves every model's `roles` header annotation against the workspace roles.yaml and reports the cross-file inconsistencies the kernel can't see. PURELY ADVISORY and NEVER BLOCKING: every finding is a WARNING (or a softer INFO) — never an error — and the verb ALWAYS exits 0, so it informs a BA / agent without stopping their work on the models. The roles file is discovered under the workspace root (auth/roles.yaml, then import/auth/roles.yaml, then user/access-rights.yaml); `--roles` overrides discovery. Models are scanned recursively (a workspace is a tree; roles gate it workspace-wide).

root.description: the workspace root directory, as passed

rolesFile.description: the resolved roles file (relative to root when under it), or null when none was found or several were (see findings)

usersFile.description: the resolved users file/dir (relative to root when under it), or null when none/several were found; --users overrides discovery

definedRoles.description: the roles declared by the resolved roles file (empty when none/ambiguous)

name.description: the role identifier a model's `roles` annotation binds to

description.description: the role's human description; absent when blank

accessRights.description: the access-right tokens the role carries

users.description: the workspace's seed users and the roles each holds (empty when no users file / ambiguous)

authorities.description: the role names this user holds (the membership edge into roles.yaml)

modelCount.description: number of document models scanned under the root

models.description: each scanned model and its gating roles (surface (c): which roles gate each model)

path.description: the model file's path relative to the scanned root

roles.description: the model's gating roles (the comma-split `roles` header annotation); empty if ungated

warnings.description: number of WARNING findings (advisory — never blocks; the verb still exits 0)

infos.description: number of INFO findings (softer, tidiness-level; also non-blocking)

findings.description: the cross-file access-control inconsistencies — roles findings first (model order), then users-edge findings (per user)

severity.description: advisory weight — never blocking: WARNING for a real cross-file inconsistency, INFO for a softer tidiness note. There is no ERROR (the verb always exits 0).

code.description: UNDEFINED_ROLE: a model gates to a role the file doesn't declare (the flagship — even the SME permits this). MISSING_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT: a roles file is present but a model carries no `roles` annotation. NO_ROLES_FILE: a model declares roles but no roles file was found. MULTIPLE_ROLES_FILES: more than one roles file (which governs is ambiguous). UNDEFINED_AUTHORITY: a user in users.yaml holds an authority (role name) the roles file doesn't declare (the users-edge twin of UNDEFINED_ROLE).

fix.description: the concrete remedy (the action to take), parity with the RK_* diagnostic `fix`

modelId.description: the offending model's id; absent for workspace-level and user findings

modelPath.description: the offending model's path relative to root; absent for workspace-level and user findings

role.description: the role/authority name in question; present for UNDEFINED_ROLE and UNDEFINED_AUTHORITY

username.description: the offending user's name; present only for UNDEFINED_AUTHORITY
